نصطحب (form VIII)
# نَصْطَحِبُ (naṣṭaḥibu) /nasˤ.tˤa.ħi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# نُصْطَحَبُ (nuṣṭaḥabu) /nusˤ.tˤa.ħa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# نَصْطَحِبَ (naṣṭaḥiba) /nasˤ.tˤa.ħi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# نُصْطَحَبَ (nuṣṭaḥaba) /nusˤ.tˤa.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
